questions.stem: Quartzmarket spent $4,000 on a campaign that produced 80 new customers for its specialty coffee. What was the customer acquisition cost?
questions.explanation: Customer acquisition cost is total campaign spend divided by customers gained, so $4,000 divided by 80 gives $50 per customer. Dividing the other way would report customers per dollar instead.
questions.hint: Divide spend by the number of new customers.

questions.stem: Quartzshores spent $4,000 on a campaign that produced 80 new customers for its bike accessories. What was the customer acquisition cost?

questions.hint: Divide spend by the number of new customers.
